description: Lets Google Certificate Manager issue the HTTPS certificate for a website InkySites hosts. Adds one CNAME record at _acme-challenge and changes nothing else.
variableDescription: acme: the per-domain label Google Certificate Manager issues for the DNS authorization, for example 0f1e2d3c-4b5a-6978-8796-a5b4c3d2e1f0.11
